findings.label: Decision model schema mismatch
findings.description: Existing tests expect loan_amount, rate_percent, emi_monthly fields (Stage 2 schema). Decision model was updated correctly but 16 tests still use old schema, causing TypeErrors. Tests in test_models.py, test_scoring.py, test_audit.py need updating or removal.
findings.action: Update or remove 16 failing tests to match new Decision schema (tier, verified_months, source_agreement_score, location_verified, photo_count, tranche_plan_json). Or: stub old fields for backward compat.

findings.label: Scoring endpoint wiring incomplete
findings.description: /api/scoring/score endpoint exists but doesn't orchestrate all 9 Phase 1 engines. Current implementation uses old pipeline. Should run source agreement → verified window → photo verification → GST coverage → tier assignment → amount rule → rate calculation → tranche plan in sequence.
findings.action: Rewrite POST /api/scoring/score to invoke Phase 1 engine pipeline, return tier + tranche_plan + reasons instead of loan_amount + emi_monthly.

findings.label: Tranche and repayment endpoints missing implementation
findings.description: /api/applications/{id}/tranches, /api/applications/{id}/repayment endpoints are stubs or mostly empty. Tranche eligibility check and EMI recording need database queries + Stop Rule Engine invocation.
findings.action: Implement tranche eligibility check (calls TrancheRuleEngine). Implement EMI recording with Stop Rule check (calls StopRuleEngine if EMI missed).

findings.label: Stop Rule Engine not invoked by repayment endpoint
findings.description: Repayment endpoint should call StopRuleEngine after recording missed EMI, but no integration visible. Frozen tranches never checked before release.
findings.action: Add StopRuleEngine invocation in repayment endpoint after recording missed/bounced EMI. Check frozen status before releasing next tranche.

findings.label: Photo Verification Engine: OCR logic is stub
findings.description: verify_code_presence() function checks if expected_code string appears in photo_data, which is mock logic. Actual handwritten code verification from uploaded photos needs ML/OCR service or manual officer review.
findings.action: Replace mock logic with either: (a) call external OCR service (e.g., AWS Rekognition, Google Vision), or (b) mark code as unverified and require officer manual review. Accept mock for demo.

findings.label: Rate Adapter database layer not used by endpoints
findings.description: RateAdapter has get_industry_rate(tier) but endpoints don't call it. Industry rates default to hardcoded values in rate_calculation_engine.py instead of querying RateEnvironment table.
findings.action: Update rate_calculation_engine.py to call RateAdapter.get_industry_rate() instead of hardcoding. Fall back to hardcoded if table empty.

findings.label: Plain language layer missing
findings.description: Tier assignment engine returns structured reasons (e.g., 'verified_months_below_6') but frontend-friendly text ('We need at least 6 months of bank data') not generated. Should convert from codes to plain text for borrower display.
findings.action: Create app/templates/reasons.py with TIER_REASONS and NEXT_TIER_REASONS dictionaries. Call in tier_assignment_engine.py to convert structured reasons to plain text.

findings.label: Test coverage concentrated in engines, not orchestration
findings.description: ~200 tests pass for individual engines (source agreement 19/19, tier assignment 23/23) but scoring endpoint tests fail (16 failures). Integration between engines (full decision pipeline) not tested.
findings.action: Fix Decision schema in old tests or remove. Add 10-15 integration tests that run full scoring pipeline end-to-end (apply → score → tier → amount → tranche).
